name: Setagaya (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Setagaya ward emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of radiating strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Setagaya, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1956.

features.role: Setagaya ward emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of radiating strokes
